purpose: Document high-level LLM usage in the MEDALS generation and evaluation artifact. Exact prompts and runtime defaults are reported in the paper supplement and reflected in the code/configuration files where applicable.

stages.purpose: Rewrite raw vec2text outputs into fluent, clinically plausible, answerable English medical questions.
stages.reproducibility_note: Closed-source LLM outputs may vary if providers update model behavior behind the same API name. The artifact therefore prioritizes prompt/configuration transparency rather than claiming bitwise reproducibility of API outputs.

stages.purpose: Generate baseline medical benchmark questions for comparison.
Score generated questions for fluency, clinical validity, and answerability.
stages.score_scale: 1-5 integer scale unless otherwise stated in the paper.
stages.aggregation: Average across valid judge outputs unless otherwise stated in the paper.

stages.purpose: Generate model answers to sampled benchmark questions.
Score model answers for accuracy, completeness, and safety.
stages.aggregation: Average across valid judge outputs unless otherwise stated in the paper.

global_notes: This file intentionally records high-level LLM provenance only. Exact prompts are documented in the supplement and/or codebase.
The artifact is framed as a code and evaluation-method release rather than a new static dataset release.
If a fixed generated question set is released later, add item-level provenance such as generation_method, rewrite_model, prompt_id, and generation_config_id.
